ITEM 1 | Cubes of golden-brown fried or roasted starchy food, about 2-3 cm pieces, with crisp browned edges and pale yellow interior, glossy surface, sitting at upper center of plate and covering roughly 15% of plate area | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark purple-black pieces with glossy skin and soft-looking cut faces, roughly 2-3 cm wedges, some with slight char, beside the cubes at center of plate, covering about 5% of plate | 45
ITEM 3 | Orange-red glazed pieces with shiny, slightly sticky sheen, about 2 cm, mixed among the dark wedges and cubes, covering about 3% of plate | 25
ITEM 4 | Pale green, spiky-textured florets with branching cone-like structure, firm and dry-looking, arranged in a crescent along the lower-left of the plate, covering about 15% of plate area | 90
ITEM 5 | Mixed loose dark green leafy greens, ruffled and slightly wilted with a light sheen, piled on the right side of the plate, covering about 20% of plate area | 60
ITEM 6 | Small pale white pieces with slight translucent edges and a few tan crumbs, scattered among the leafy greens on the right, covering about 3% of plate | 12
ITEM 7 | Thin light-colored liquid residue and faint oily smear on the white plate surface near the left edge of the food | 3
